lower_bound.statement: Record: proofs/certificates/floor_cert/tn36 (confirmed on the official game file). Method: engine breadth-first search (6449 nodes, no shorter win) and the opcode dynamic program; program 3,3,3,3,3. No level 1-5 run has a collectible or a portal, a failed run restores position, rotation, scale, color and alive, and the program words are the only memory; Hamming distance obeys the triangle inequality, so the toggles along any run are bounded below by the program distance. The dynamic program finds a program whose length equals the floor; the opcode sample has 0 mismatches. proofs/certificates/floor_cert/tn36/logs/replay.json replays the certificate route: it wins at the floor and its prefix one action shorter does not.
